_note: ILLUSTRATIVE SHAPE ONLY — do not assert this structure. The JSON is a mechanical projection of whatever XML your handler returned, so the keys will be YOUR element names, including PascalCase and any vendor prefixes. What you SHOULD assert: content-type is application/json, the body parses, and the body contains no XML markup. The last one is the real test — a content-type header is a claim, a body with no angle brackets is evidence.
_watch_for: If the handler returns exactly ONE <Site>, this may be an object rather than a one-element array. XML cannot distinguish an item from a list of one. Test both shapes and publish both — see tests/test-plan.yaml case single-vs-multiple-elements.
